7.18 Balance the following redox reactions by ion – electron method :
(a) MnO4- (aq) + I- (aq) → MnO2 (s) + I2(s) (in basic medium)
(b) MnO4- (aq) + SO2 (g) → Mn2+ (aq) + HSO4- (aq) (in acidic solution)
(c) H2O2 (aq) + Fe2+ (aq) → Fe3+ (aq) + H2O (l) (in acidic solution)
(d) Cr2O72- + SO2(g) → Cr3+ (aq) + SO42- (aq) (in acidic solution)
note: Crop is exercise 7.18 with four sub-equations (a)-(d), not one equation. latex carries sub-equation (a) ('in basic medium' is printed after it as a condition, kept out of the latex); all four are copied exactly into text. Excluded as neighbours: the page header '254 ... CHEMISTRY' (clipped at the right edge), the preceding line 'What inference do you draw about the behaviour of Ag+ and Cu2+ from these reactions ?', and the following item '7.19 Balance the following equations in basic medium by ion-electron method and oxidation number methods and identify the oxidising agent and the reducing agent.'
